title: DCA miniapp
tagline: Make your idle USDC hustle, set DCA plans straight from your Farcaster wallet.
description:
Over $45M USDC is just sitting idle in Farcaster wallets.
Markets are moving. Your USDC isn’t.

That changes today.

Meet DCA MiniApp (@DCAapp)
- Pick your token
- Set your amount + frequency
- Let us do the heavy lifting with micro-transactions

Why you’ll want this:
- That “I’ll buy later” moment? Turns into never.
- Watching charts all day = zero fun.
- Missing runs while your coins nap in your wallet? Pain.

How it works:
1. Create a position
2. Approve USDC
3. We auto-execute regular buys for you
simple

Why it’s different:
- Fully on-chain
- Funds stay in your wallet until each buy
- No middlemen. No custody. No drama.
how_its_made:
The project is made with next js framework, and it user farcaster sdk
and serves as a farcaster mini app
and the cron for it is running on aws (lambda)
backend is hosted on postgres (with neon db) (prisma orm)
and apis are on next js only.

for contract development i've used foundry
and deployed from remix
